description: This file provides utility functions for composing visual elements into frames, including creation of blank images, drawing shapes (circle, star), adding text, and creating gradient backgrounds, primarily for animation or visual presentations.

methods.name: Image.Image create_blank_frame( width: int, height: int, color: tuple[int, int, int] = (255, 255, 255) )
methods.description: Creates a new blank image with specified width, height, and background color.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_circle( frame: Image.Image, center: tuple[int, int], radius: int, fill_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_width: int = 1, )
methods.description: Draws a circle with given center, radius, fill color, outline color, and outline width on a provided image.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_text( frame: Image.Image, text: str, position: tuple[int, int], color: tuple[int, int, int] = (0, 0, 0), centered: bool = False, )
methods.description: Adds text to a frame at a specified position, optionally centered, with specified color.

methods.name: Image.Image create_gradient_background( width: int, height: int, top_color: tuple[int, int, int], bottom_color: tuple[int, int, int], )
methods.description: Generates a vertical gradient background image between two colors over specified dimensions.

methods.name: Image.Image draw_star( frame: Image.Image, center: tuple[int, int], size: int, fill_color: tuple[int, int, int], outline_color: Optional[tuple[int, int, int]] = None, outline_width: int = 1, )
methods.description: Draws a five-pointed star at a specified location and size, with fill and optional outline.
